blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT ( N = 878 N=878 ) and DiDeMo ( N = 980 N=980 ), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15 % 15\% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R 2 R^{2} of 0.838 0.838 – 0.969 0.969 , matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864 0.864 – 0.963 0.963 , and response-sign accuracies of 0.909 0.909 – 0.989 0.989 , whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V / ( g V + ε ) V/(g_{V}+\varepsilon) , fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal representation learning increasingly maps heterogeneous signals into shared embedding spaces, where semantic agreement across modalities is measured by pairwise similarity. This design underlies contrastive vision–language models [ 1 , 2 ] , joint video–audio–text embeddings [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] , and video–text retrieval systems built on such representations [ 7 ] . Beyond pairwise similarity, recent work has introduced geometric scores that operate on several modality embeddings jointly: GRAM measures the volume of a Gramian parallelotope as a higher-order multimodal alignment quantity [ 8 ] , and HyperGRAM extends this construction with Euclidean–hyperbolic geometry [ 9 ] . In these models, the geometry itself is part of the learning objective, so the behavior of the geometric score under degraded inputs directly affects how the model treats difficult or corrupted samples.
blocks.zh: 多式联运表达式学习越来越多地将各种信号映射到共享嵌入空间中,在该空间中,跨模式的语义一致用对等相似性来衡量。 这种设计是对比视觉-语言模型[1、2]、联合视频-音频-文本嵌入[3、4、5、6]和基于这种表述的视频-文本检索系统的基础。 除了对等相似性之外,最近的工作引入了几何分数,在几种模式嵌入上共同操作: GRAM 测量格莱米亚同位素的体积,作为更高级的多式对齐量[8],HyperGRAM 将这种构造与 Euclidean-hyperbolic 几何相扩展[9]. 在这些模型中,几何本身是学习目标的一部分,因此在退化输入下几何分数的行为会直接影响模型如何处理困难或被腐蚀的样品.

blocks.en: This raises a basic question for interpreting geometric multimodal representations: how does the geometric score respond when one modality is degraded? A natural first hypothesis is magnitude-based. If a modality is perturbed more strongly, the score should change more strongly; under this view, a scalar displacement magnitude should organize most of the response variability, and sample-dependent deviations should be secondary. Related intuition from reliability-aware and incomplete-multimodal learning [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] suggests that a scalar modality-quality signal should be sufficient to describe how strongly a degraded sample is affected. Controlled-perturbation studies in unimodal settings have likewise analyzed model behavior as a function of corruption strength [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 这为解释几何多式表述提出了一个基本问题:当一种模式退化时,几何分数如何反应? 一个自然的第一个假设是基于量的. 如果一种方式受到更强烈的干扰,得分应更强烈地改变;根据这种观点,一个分级的转移量应组织大多数反应可变性,而依赖样本的偏差应是次要的. 从可靠性意识和不完全的多式学习中得出的相关直觉[10、11、12、13、14]表明,一个分级模式质量信号应足以说明退化样品受到多大影响。 在单一模式环境下进行的受控制-干扰研究同样分析了模型行为作为腐败力量的一种作用[15]。

blocks.en: We test the magnitude hypothesis directly rather than assuming it. We freeze the representation model and construct controlled perturbations on two video–text–audio retrieval benchmarks, MSR-VTT [ 16 ] and DiDeMo [ 17 ] . Video degradation is introduced by Gaussian blur and audio degradation by additive white Gaussian noise, one modality at a time. For each sample, we measure the displacement induced by degradation in the relational geometry itself—the vector of pairwise cosine similarities on which the geometric score is defined—and compare it with the change in the geometric volume. The resulting anomaly is clear: displacement magnitude explains at most 15 % 15\% of the out-of-sample variance of the absolute volume response, and pairs matched for magnitude can have very different responses. Magnitude alone does not determine the response, and the tested scalar severity descriptions do not organize it either.

blocks.en: This paper makes four contributions, stated as scientific findings rather than as new modules: • We show empirically, across MSR-VTT and DiDeMo and across video and audio degradation axes, that perturbation magnitude alone provides weak out-of-sample explanatory power for the response of a multimodal geometric score, and that magnitude-matched pairs remain heterogeneous. • We systematically evaluate and reject several simpler scalar explanations under fixed decision rules, including context-based and local self-sensitivity reliability proxies and the direction-free gain–magnitude product ‖ ∇ V ‖ ​ D \|\nabla V\|D . • We identify and empirically validate a first-order directional mechanism, termed Directional Geometric Response (DGR), which jointly accounts for the clean operating point, perturbation magnitude, and perturbation direction, and we quantify its approximation error and higher-order effects. • We conduct a pre-specified audit of gain normalization and show that the tested V / ( g V + ε ) V/(g_{V}+\varepsilon) family does not consistently improve response predictability while preserving clean geometric ordering, thereby establishing the boundary of the mechanism rather than a new calibration method.

blocks.en: The scope is deliberately bounded. DGR is an explanatory oracle, not an inference-time predictor; the first-order approximation is not uniformly exact, with higher-order effects appreciable on the audio axes; and the evidence covers two datasets and two perturbation families. The paper makes no claim of a new robustness method or universal law. Its objective is to characterize the response mechanism of a concrete multimodal geometric representation under controlled degradation, and to delineate what that characterization supports and what it does not.
blocks.zh: 范围是故意划定的。 DGR是一个解释性预言,而不是一个推论时间的预测器;一阶近似不统一准确,对音频轴具有可观的更高阶效应;证据涵盖两个数据集和两个扰动家族. 本文没有提出新的稳健性方法或普遍法的主张. 其目的是说明在受控制的退化下具体的多式几何表示的反应机制的特点,并界定这种表示支持什么和不支持什么。

blocks.en: We also stress the methodological status of the finding. The first-order expansion itself is elementary, and we do not present it as a mathematical contribution. The contribution is the empirical discovery that this directional first-order term systematically explains response heterogeneity across four dataset–degradation cells, whereas magnitude-only and direction-free alternatives fail under out-of-sample and matched-magnitude tests. The paper is accordingly positioned as an empirical mechanism discovery supported by controlled perturbation and a falsification-oriented evaluation, not as a new mathematical theory.
blocks.zh: 我们还强调调查结果的方法状况。 第一顺序扩展本身是基本的,我们不把它作为数学贡献来呈现. 其贡献在于经验发现,这个定向一阶词系统地解释了四个数据集-降解细胞的响应异质性,而量的和无方向的替代品则在样本外和相匹配的放大测试下失效. 因此,论文被定位为一种经验性机制发现,辅以受控扰动和以伪造为取向的评价,而不是一种新的数学理论.

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. Section II positions the study within related work. Section III presents the geometric formulation, the perturbation protocol, and the evaluation rules. Sections IV – VI report the anomaly, the rejected scalar explanations, and the directional mechanism. Section VII describes the gain-normalization audit, Section VIII discusses implications and limitations, and Section IX concludes.

blocks.zh: II-A 多式联运和几何对称

blocks.en: Shared embedding spaces have become a standard mechanism for multimodal learning [ 18 ] . CLIP establishes scalable image–text alignment through contrastive learning [ 1 ] , ALIGN scales this recipe with noisy web-scale text [ 2 ] , and VATT extends multimodal self-supervision to raw video, audio, and text [ 3 ] . ImageBind and LanguageBind demonstrate that a shared semantic space can connect a larger number of modalities [ 4 , 5 ] , and VAST explicitly models vision, audio, subtitle, and text in an omni-modality foundation model [ 6 ] . On the application side, CLIP4Clip studies how contrastive image–text representations transfer to video–text retrieval on the benchmarks used in this paper [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 共享嵌入空间已成为多模式学习的标准机制[18]. CLIP通过对比性学习建立可缩放的图像 — 文本对齐 [1], ALIGN用吵闹的网络尺度文本来缩放这种配方 [2], VATT 将多式自导自演扩展至原始视频,音频,文本 [3]. ImageBind和LanguageBind表明,一个共享的语义空间可以将更多的模式[4,5]连接起来,而VAST则以全模式基模型[6]明确了模型视觉,音频,字幕,和文本. 在应用方面,CLIP4Clip研究了对比图像-文本表达法如何在本文使用的基准上转移到视频-文本检索[7].

blocks.en: A growing line of work replaces purely pairwise alignment with joint geometric constructions. GRAM measures a Gramian volume over multiple modality embeddings [ 8 ] , and HyperGRAM extends this construction to hyperbolic space, combining Euclidean and hyperbolic volumes [ 9 ] . Hyperbolic representation learning more broadly has been motivated by the capacity of hyperbolic spaces to represent hierarchical structure [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] , MERU applies such geometry to image–text representation learning [ 22 ] , and hyperbolic geometry has recently been combined with safety awareness in vision–language models [ 23 ] . Metric-geometry considerations, including how similarity objectives shape the embedding geometry, have been analyzed in the metric learning literature [ 24 ] . These studies primarily evaluate representation quality and downstream retrieval. In contrast, we hold the representation fixed and ask how its geometric score itself changes under controlled modality perturbation.
blocks.zh: 不断增长的工程线取代了纯粹对等的组合式几何构造. GRAM在多模式嵌入[8]上度量出一个格莱美体积,HyperGRAM将这种构造延伸到了双曲空间,结合了欧几利得和双曲体积[9]. 更广义的双曲表达学习的动机在于双曲空间能够代表分级结构[19,20,21],MERU将这种几何学应用于图像-文本表达学习[22],而双曲几何学最近与视觉-语言模型的安全意识[23]结合. 计量几何方面的考虑,包括相似性目标如何塑造嵌入几何,在计量学文献中进行了分析[24]. 这些研究主要评价代表质量和下游检索。 与此相对照,我们把表示固定下来,并询问它的几何分数本身在受控模式扰动下的变化如何.

blocks.en: II-B Multimodal Missingness, Perturbation, and Reliability
blocks.zh: 二-B 多式联运的缺失、干扰和可靠性

blocks.en: Multimodal learning has long recognized that modalities differ in quality, availability, and optimization behavior [ 18 ] . What Makes Multi-Modal Networks Hard studies unequal modality learning dynamics [ 10 ] ; SMIL addresses severely missing modalities during training and testing [ 11 ] ; ShaSpec handles missing modalities through shared–specific feature modelling [ 13 ] ; multimodal prompting recovers recognition performance when modalities are absent at test time [ 25 ] ; and QMF provides a quality-aware dynamic fusion framework with robustness guarantees on low-quality multimodal data [ 14 ] . Trusted Multi-View Classification estimates sample-dependent evidence and uncertainty for multiple views [ 12 ] . In a parallel unimodal line, corruption benchmarks measure how classification degrades under controlled common corruptions [ 15 ] . These works motivate the intuitive hypothesis that the response of a geometric score under degradation might be explained by a scalar modality-quality or reliability variable.
blocks.zh: 多式联运学习早已认识到,模式在质量、可用性和优化行为方面各不相同[18]。 何为多模态 网络 硬性研究不平等模式学习动态[10]; SMIL在培训和测试过程中解决了严重缺失模式[11]; ShaSpec通过共享的 -- -- 特定特征建模处理缺失模式[13]; 当测试时模式缺失时,多模式促进恢复识别性能[25]; QMF在低质量多模式数据上提供了有强性保障的质量意识动态聚变框架[14]. 信任的"多维分类法"估计了依赖样本的证据和多种观点的不确定性[12]. 在一条平行的单式行中,腐败基准衡量在受控制的共同腐败下如何降解。 这些作品激发出直观的假设,即几何分数在降解后的反应可能由斯卡尔模式质量或可靠性变量来解释.

blocks.en: Our analysis tests that hypothesis in a different setting. Rather than optimizing a model to compensate for missing or unreliable modalities, we examine the local response of an already-trained geometric score. The distinction matters: a reliability variable can describe how much a modality is compromised, but it need not describe which relational direction the resulting representation displacement takes. Our experiments show that the latter is essential for the geometric score studied here.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析测试这个假说 在不同的环境下。 我们不但没有优化模型以补偿缺失或不可靠的模式,而是审查已经训练有素的几何分数的局部反应. 区别很重要:一个可靠性变量可以描述一种方式受到多大损害,但它不需要描述由此产生的代表转移所要遵循的关系方向。 我们的实验表明,后者对于这里研究的几何分数至关重要.

blocks.en: II-C Local Perturbation and Representation Analysis
blocks.zh: II-C 当地扰动和代表分析

blocks.en: Gradient-based local sensitivity is a standard tool for understanding neural networks. Saliency methods use input gradients to explain predictions [ 26 ] , influence functions trace predictions back to training perturbations through first-order expansions [ 27 ] , and adversarial-perturbation studies demonstrate that small input changes can induce highly nonuniform model responses [ 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] . This paper is not an adversarial-robustness study: the perturbations here are controlled signal degradations applied to a frozen multimodal encoder. The analysis is nevertheless geometrically local. Because the final Gramian volume has a closed-form derivative, the first-order response can be tested directly against the measured score change rather than approximated through a generic sensitivity heuristic, and the direction of the induced displacement in relational coordinates becomes an observable quantity.
blocks.zh: 基于渐变的局部敏感性是理解神经网络的标准工具. 重要方法使用输入梯度来解释预测 [26],影响函数痕量预测通过一阶扩张回溯到训练扰动 [27],对抗-扰动研究表明,小输入变化可以诱导高度非统一模型响应 [28,29,30,31]. 本文不是一项对抗-活性研究:这里的扰动是适用于被冻结的多式编码器的控制信号降解. 然而,这种分析是局部几何分析。 由于最终格莱米亚体积有闭式衍生物,可以直接对照所测得的分数变化来测试一阶响应,而不是通过通用的灵敏度heuristic来进行近似测试,被诱发在关系坐标上的位置会变成可观测的数量.

blocks.en: Overall, existing multimodal work mainly asks how to learn, align, complete, or robustify multimodal representations, and existing perturbation analysis mainly characterizes sensitivity to perturbation strength. What remains underexplored is how a geometric multimodal score responds to the direction of the displacement induced in its own relational geometry. This paper addresses that gap.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,现有的多式工作主要询问如何学习、调整、完成或强化多式表述,而现有的扰动分析主要说明扰动强度的敏感性。 尚未充分探讨的是,几何多式计分法如何对自身关系几何中引起的迁移方向作出反应。 本文涉及这一差距。

III-D Datasets and Controlled Perturbations
blocks.zh: 三-D 数据集和受控扰动

blocks.en: We use MSR-VTT [ 16 ] and DiDeMo [ 17 ] , two standard video–text retrieval benchmarks with three usable modalities (text, video, audio). The analysis uses fixed cohorts rather than dynamically filtering samples during evaluation. The final MSR-VTT cohort contains N = 878 N=878 samples after excluding 116 videos without usable audio tracks and 6 silent tracks; the DiDeMo cohort contains N = 980 N=980 samples after excluding 5 videos without audio and 19 silent tracks. MSR-VTT membership is enforced by an immutable identifier list, so the analyzed cohort is exactly reproducible. A third benchmark such as ActivityNet [ 32 ] is discussed as a possible external test in Section VIII but is deliberately not used to broaden the mechanism claim after the four-cell result was obtained.
blocks.zh: 我们使用MSR-VTT [16] 和 DiDeMo [17],两个标准视频-文本检索基准,有三个可用的模式(文本、视频、音频)。 分析采用固定组群,而不是在评价期间动态过滤样本。 最终的MSR-VTT组包含N=878 N=878个样本,此前排除了116个没有可用音频音轨的视频和6个无声道;DiDeMo组包含N=980 N=980个样本,此前排除了5个没有音频的视频和19个无声道. MSR-VTT成员由不可改变的标识列表强制,因此被分析的组群完全可以复制. 第八节讨论了第三个基准,如活动网[32],作为可能的外部测试,但在获得四细胞结果后,故意不用于扩大机制索赔。

blocks.en: III-E 1 Out-of-Sample Variance Explained

blocks.en: For each candidate scalar s s , we fit an ordinary least-squares linear regression of | Δ ​ V | |\Delta V| on s s with an intercept on the training folds and evaluate the coefficient of determination on the held-out fold; held-out predictions are collected across folds, and the reported value is the pooled five-fold out-of-sample R 2 R^{2} computed over all held-out predictions under a fixed seeded fold assignment, with no tuning (the closed-form fit has no hyperparameters). The fold partition is shared across candidates within a cell, so comparisons between candidates reflect the candidates rather than the partition. Negative R 2 R^{2} means worse than predicting the training mean.

It establishes that the most direct gain-removal family derived from the first-order decomposition does not consistently remove the observed response heterogeneity and can distort clean geometric ordering. blocks.en: VIII Discussion
blocks.zh: 八. 讨论情况

blocks.en: VIII-A What the Results Establish
blocks.zh: 八-A 成果的确定

blocks.en: Five observations form a coherent chain. First, relational displacement magnitude is insufficient: its out-of-sample explanatory power is low, and magnitude-matched pairs remain heterogeneous in both size and sign. Second, the natural scalar alternatives—context-based reliability, self-sensitivity, and the direction-free gain–magnitude product—fail under the same gates. Third, the local first-order projection explains the heterogeneity across two datasets and two perturbation axes. Fourth, removing only the local gain does not solve the problem, because the response also depends on direction and because score-side normalization can change clean ordering. Fifth, the mechanism survives its own stress test: even where the first-order pointwise error is large (audio axes), the directional structure dominates the response.
blocks.zh: 5个观察形成一个连贯的链. 第一,关系性迁移的程度不足:其外表解释力很低,规模相匹配的一对在大小和标志上仍然各不相同。 第二,自然的平面选择——基于文字的可靠性、自我敏感性和无方向收益——放大产品——在同一大门下失败。 第三,局部一阶投影解释出两个数据集和两个扰动轴的异相. 第四,只去除本地收益并不能解决问题,因为反应也取决于方向,也因为得分方正常化可以改变干净的订单. 第五,机能在自身应力测试中幸存下来:即使一阶指向误差较大(自动轴)的地方,方向结构主导了响应.

blocks.en: This chain matters for geometric multimodal learning. A score can be highly sensitive to its operating point without that sensitivity being an undesirable calibration artifact. Treating every form of condition dependence as nuisance variation can erase meaningful structure rather than improve robustness.
blocks.zh: 这种链条对于几何多式学习很重要. 分数可以对其操作点高度敏感,而这种敏感度不是一种不受欢迎的校准文物. 将任何形式的条件依赖都视为危害性变化,可以抹去有意义的结构,而不是提高稳健性。

blocks.en: VIII-B What the Results Do Not Establish
blocks.zh: 八-B 成果没有确立的内容

blocks.en: Equally important is what the evidence does not support. The analysis does not establish causality; degradation is experimentally applied, but the explanatory claims are associational descriptions of a response mechanism. It is not a theorem for all multimodal representations, nor is it universal across datasets: the evidence covers MSR-VTT and DiDeMo, Gaussian blur, additive white Gaussian noise, and the tested perturbation strengths. The high R 2 R^{2} of DGR does not make it a deployment-time predictor, since it uses the observed degraded-state displacement. The negative audit does not prove that all gain-normalization methods fail, only the tested V / ( g V + ε ) V/(g_{V}+\varepsilon) family. Finally, nothing here shows that HyperGRAM [ 9 ] or Gramian volumes [ 8 ] are flawed as representation-learning objectives, nor that geometric volume lacks retrieval utility; the results characterize how such a score responds to degradation, not whether it should be used.
blocks.zh: 同样重要的是,证据不支持什么。 分析没有确定因果关系;退化是试验性的,但解释性索赔是对反应机制的关联性描述。 它不是所有多式表示的定理,也不是跨越数据集的通用性:证据涵盖MSR-VTT和DiDeMo,高斯模糊,添加剂白高斯噪声,被测试的扰动强度. DGR的高R 2 R^{2}并不能使它成为部署时间的预测器,因为它使用了所观测到的退化状态流离失所. 负面审计不能证明所有增益常态化方法都失败了,只有被测试的V / (g V + ε) V (g_{ V}+\varepsilon)家族. 最后,这里没有任何东西显示HyperGRAM[9]或Gramian卷[8]作为表现-学习目标存在缺陷,也不显示几何体积缺乏检索效用;结果说明这种分数如何应对退化,而不是是否应该使用.

blocks.en: VIII-C Implications for Multimodal Geometric Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 八-C 对多式几何表示法学习的影响

blocks.en: The results suggest, cautiously, that future multimodal geometric learning methods may need to consider local directional geometry rather than treating perturbation severity as a scalar quantity. For evaluation, perturbation studies on geometric scores may benefit from reporting displacement direction statistics alongside severity, since scalar severity summaries can hide the directional variation that drives responses. For robustness-oriented design, interventions that rescale a geometric score by a scalar gain may be structurally mismatched to a mechanism in which direction, not gain, carries the dominant heterogeneity. These implications are stated with “may” deliberately: they follow from two datasets and two perturbation families and should be re-tested as new geometric scores and degradation regimes emerge.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,谨慎地说,未来的多模式几何学习方法可能需要考虑局部方向几何,而不是将扰动严重性作为平分量处理。 就评价而言,关于几何分数的扰动研究可能得益于报告流离失所方向统计数字和严重程度,因为分级严重程度摘要可以掩盖驱动反应的方向变化。 对于以稳健性为导向的设计而言,以平面增益来调整几何分数的干预措施,可能在结构上不匹配到一种机制,在这种机制中,取向而不是取益都具有主要的异质性。 这些影响是用“可能”故意表示的:它们来自两个数据集和两个扰动家庭,应当随着新的几何分数和退化制度的出现而重新测试。

blocks.en: VIII-D Limitations and Scope
blocks.zh: 八-D 限制和范围

blocks.en: The limitations are concrete. (1) Two datasets only: MSR-VTT and DiDeMo; ActivityNet [ 32 ] would be a natural external test. (2) Two perturbation families only: Gaussian blur and additive white Gaussian noise, at the tested strengths. (3) The analysis concerns one specific Gramian-volume geometry [ 8 , 9 ] ; other geometric scores may respond differently. (4) The first-order approximation is less accurate under stronger audio perturbations, with median relative deviations of roughly 39 39 – 41 % 41\% . (5) DGR is explanatory and oracle-like, because Δ ​ 𝐨 \Delta\mathbf{o} is observed after degradation. (6) The study does not establish causal mechanisms beyond the controlled perturbation design. (7) The negative audit does not test every geometric normalization; it tests the pre-specified family.
blocks.zh: 限制是具体的。 (1)只有两个数据集:MSR-VTT和DiDeMo;活动网[32]将是自然的外部测试. (2)只有两个扰动家族:高斯模糊和添加出白高斯噪音,处于被测试的优势. (3)分析涉及一个特定的格莱美体积几何[8,9];其他几何分数可能反应不同. (4)在更强的音频扰动下,一阶近似值的准确度较低,相对偏差中位数约为39-41 % 41-Q. (5) DGR具有解释性并类似甲骨文,因为在退化后观测到o\Delta\mathbf{o}. (6) 本研究没有确立超出受控扰动设计的因果机制. (7)负面审计并不测试每一个几何常态;它测试预先指定的家族.

blocks.en: IX Conclusion
blocks.zh: 九. 结论

blocks.en: We studied how a multimodal Gramian volume responds when one modality is degraded. Across two video–text–audio datasets and two controlled degradation axes, perturbation magnitude alone explains little of the response, and several natural scalar explanations fail under fixed decision rules. A first-order local analysis instead shows that the response is jointly structured by the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and, critically, displacement direction; the magnitude of the first-order DGR term is strongly explanatory across all four dataset–axis cells, while direction-free gain–magnitude products do not provide a stable explanation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了一种模式退化时一种多式格莱美体积的反应方式。 在两个视频-文本-音频数据集和两个受控制的降解轴上,扰动量本身几乎无法解释反应,而且根据固定的决定规则,若干自然平面解释失败了。 相反,第一顺序局部分析表明,反应是由干净的操作点、迁移规模以及关键的迁移方向共同构成的;第一顺序DGR术语的大小在所有四个数据集(轴细胞)中都有很强的解释性,而无方向收益(magnity Production)产品并不能提供稳定的解释性。

blocks.en: The same analysis establishes a boundary. The local gradient gain is real and mechanistically relevant, but the pre-specified V / ( g V + ε ) V/(g_{V}+\varepsilon) normalization family neither consistently improves response predictability nor preserves clean geometric ordering. We therefore do not turn the mechanism into a score-side calibration method. The resulting picture is deliberately modest but useful: geometric perturbation responses are condition-dependent because the same amount of relational movement can point in different directions relative to the local geometry. Beyond perturbation magnitude, multimodal geometric response depends on the interaction between the operating point, perturbation magnitude, and perturbation direction. Understanding and exploiting that directional structure—without assuming it can be divided out—is left as a future problem.
blocks.zh: 同样的分析确定了界限。 局部梯度增益是真实的,在机械上是相通的,但是预先指定的V / (g V + ε)V/ (g_{ V}+\varepsilon) 正常化家族既不能一贯地提高响应的可预测性,也不能保存干净的几何顺序. 因此,我们不把机制变成记分方校正方法。 由此而来相片刻意适度而有用:几何扰动反应是取决于条件的,因为同量的关系运动可以指向与局部几何不同的方向. 除了扰动量外,多式几何反应还取决于操作点,扰动量和扰动方向之间的相互作用. 理解和利用这一方向结构——不假定它可以分开——将成为一个未来问题。
